name: @juli-os/ledger
description: juli-os L1 layer: the ledger of record for agent work — workflows, steps, case files, and token usage in one zero-dependency SQLite layer.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild bin/juli-ledger.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/juli-ledger.js && chmod +x dist/juli-ledger.js && python3 scripts/postbuild.py
scripts.smoke:dist: node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(async m => { const { join } = await import('node:path'); const { tmpdir } = await import('node:os'); const s = m.createLedgerStore(join(tmpdir(), 'peel-dist-' + Date.now() + '.db')); const wf = s.createWorkflow({kind:'case',title:'dist smoke'}); if (!s.getWorkflow(wf.id)) process.exit(1); console.log('DIST SMOKE OK'); })"
